name: 1,000,000 Meso Coin
desc: A precious coin that can be sold to shops for 1,000,000 mesos.

name: Unity Training Center Entrance Charm (12 hours)
desc: This charm grants you the power to enter the #cUnity Training Center within Mu Lung Dojo# where you #cautomatically gain EXP# based on your character's level.

name: Kaleido-Spinner Event Ticket
desc: A ticket that allows you to use the Kaleido-Spinner at the #cHaunted Mansion#. Looks like some lucky people can get pretty nifty items.

name: Monster Park REBORN Coupon
desc: This coupon is consumed when you clear the Monster Park REBORN dungeon, granting you free entry. #c\nPlease check the expiration date and use it before it expires!

name: Faint Stigma Spirit Stone
desc: A Spirit Stone marked with the brand of the demon. It reeks of a faint energy.

name: Twisted Stigma Spirit Stone
desc: A Spirit Stone marked with the brand of the demon. This one is twisted, and seethes with dark energy.

name: 20 Million Meso Voucher
desc: A commemorative voucher to help new characters settle in. You can sell it to the shop for 20 million Mesos!

name: 30 Million Mesos Voucher
desc: A commemorative voucher to help new characters settle in. You can sell it to the shop for 30 million Mesos!

name: 50 Million Mesos Voucher
desc: A commemorative voucher to help new characters settle in. You can sell it to the shop for 50 million Mesos!

name: Gold Clover
desc: An Otherworld Clover made of gold. You can sell it to the shop for 5 million mesos.

name: Silver Clover
desc: An Otherworld Clover made of silver. You can sell it to the shop for 3 million mesos.

name: Bronze Clover
desc: An Otherworld Clover made of bronze. You can sell it to the shop for 1 million mesos.

name: 12th Anniversary Maple Leaf
desc: A marvelous maple leaf commemorating the 12th Anniversary. #Henesys and Leafre are competing to see which town can collect the most of these.#

name: Damaged Black Heart
desc: Although incomplete, this mechanical heart beats with incredible force.\nSomeone in Haven might be able to fix it.

name: Arcane River Droplet Stone
desc: This clump of Erda was shaped into the form of a stone droplet by the Arcane River. It bears magical power.

name: Butterfly Droplet Stone
desc: Lucid's magical power fills this droplet stone.

name: Unity Training Center Entrance Charm (9 hours)
desc: This charm grants you the power to enter the #cUnity Training Center within Mu Lung Dojo# where you #cautomatically gain EXP# based on your character's level.

name: Unity Training Center Entrance Charm (24 hours)
desc: This charm grants you the power to enter the #cUnity Training Center within Mu Lung Dojo# where you #cautomatically gain EXP# based on your character's level.

name: 13th Anniversary Premium PC Cafe Coin
desc:
A Premium PC Cafe Coin issued for the 13th Anniversary. 
It can be sold for a special price to #cNPC Gold Richie at Free Market Entrance.#

#cGold Richie Purchase Period: Until TKTKTK QRQRQR.

name: Sub-Zero Hunt Trial Pass
desc: A pass that restores the #cmonster population# of the #cSub-Zero Hunt# to 3,000 for free when you give it to #cFrappe.#

name: Hunter's Arena Coupon
desc: A coupon that recharges the #cnumber of huntable monsters# to 500 when you give it to #cCassandra# at the #cHunter's Arena#.

name: Intense Power Crystal
desc: A soul crystal left behind by someone with intense power. The crystal is divided equally amongst party members. Has no special function, but you can sell it at a high price to a \r#Collector# who hangs out at the \r#Free Market Entrance#. But remember, the Collector only purchases \r#set quantities during specific time frames#.

name: Gold Richie Coin
desc: A Gold Richie commemorative coin. You can sell it for 7 Million Mesos if you take it to #cGold Richie# at the Free Market Entrance. You can find out #when you can sell these by talking to Gold Richie.

name: Stone Origin Droplet
desc: This bit of Esferan Erda has formed into a magical stone droplet.

name: Stone Cobweb Droplet
desc: This magical stone droplet is filled with Will's power.

name: Spark of Determination
desc: A spark filled with the willpower of the warriors of the Alliance. Take the Spark of Determination and the Shadow of Annihilation to Lorelei to obtain an object that'll help open the path to the Black Mage.

name: Shadow of Annihilation
desc: A vile fragment of power acquired from defeating Verus Hilla. Within this churning chaos you can feel the essence of the Black Mage. Take the Spark of Determination and the Shadow of Annihilation to Lorelei to obtain an object that'll help open the path to the Black Mage.

name: Fragment of Destiny
desc: An extraordinary fragment earned by following the Journey of Destiny. You must have this to gain access to the Black Mage's inner sanctum.

name: Blue Flame
desc: This scorchingly hot blue flame might just set fire to anything it comes into contact with.

name: Mighty Jewel Powder
desc: Strength-infused powdered jewels. Collect several to exchange for a Magical Jewel Box.

name: Lucky Jewel Powder
desc: Luck-infused powdered jewels. Collect several to exchange for a Magical Jewel Box.

name: Keen Jewel Powder
desc: Wisdom-infused powdered jewels. Collect several to exchange for a Magical Jewel Box.

name: Nimble Jewel Powder
desc: Dexterity-infused powdered jewels. Collect several to exchange for a Magical Jewel Box.

name: Straw Voodoo Doll
desc: A doll made out of straw.

name: Wooden Voodoo Doll
desc: A doll made out of wood.

name: Piece of Secret Book
desc: Everybody wants a piece of this book. It's full of mysterious words.

name: Sage Cat Doll
desc: A stuffed animal with the Sage Cat's soul trapped inside.

name: Training Certificate
desc: A training certificate you get for defeating the Master Dummy. It shows you trained for a very long time.

name: Anti-magic Stone
desc: An intact anti-magic stone. You can exchange anti-magic collected in Anti-magic items and stones with Kritias Commemorative Coins.

name: Oak Tree Acorn
desc: A small acorn that squirrels were playing with.

name: Red Porky Thorn
desc: Thorns from Red Porky's back. Ouch!

name: Black Porky Thorn
desc: Thorns from Black Porky's back. Ouch!

name: Snake Skin
desc: Quality snake leather. The snake's patterns are featured clearly on it.

name: Red Flower Serpent Pompom
desc: A flower off of a Red Flower Serpent.

name: Giant Centipede Marble
desc: A red marble from a Giant Centipede.

name: Trainee's Belt
desc: A belt given to bears at the beginning of their training.

name: Broken Antler
desc: An antler of a White Deer, which you broke off...

name: Nectarine Seed
desc: A seed spat out by a Peach Monkey.

name: Apprentice's Belt
desc: Only experienced bears are allowed to wear these.

name: Bear Paw
desc: A thick bear paw.

name: Broken Pot Fragmen
desc: A piece of a broken pot.

name: Ginseng Water
desc: A hot pot that contains water that's been boiling with ginseng for a long time.

name: Bellflower
desc: A common bellflower you can find in the mountains.

name: 100-Year-Old Bellflower
desc: A super old bellflower grown to be a hundred years old.

name: Mr. Alli's Alligator Leather
desc: Nice Alligator leather.

name: Marine Map Piece
desc: A piece of a pirate map.

name: Navigation Room Key
desc: Key to the pirates' Navigation Room.

name: Pirates's Voyage Log
desc: A voyage logbook of Lord Pirate's piracy activities

name: Lord Pirate's Hook
desc: Lord Pirate's hand, shaped like a hook.

name: Patrol Robot Memory Card
desc: A Patrol Robot's memory card. It's used to control the Robot.

name: Clean Water Bottle
desc: A water bottle stolen by the Water Thief.

name: Trash Bag
desc: A black trash bag that came out of a Dust Box.

name: Streetlight Structure
desc: A tentacle from the side of a Streetlight.

name: Patrol Robot S Memory Card
desc: A Patrol Robot S's memory card. It's used to control the Robot.

name: Guard Robot E's Memory Chip
desc: Guard Robot E's memory chip. It's used to control the Robot.

name: Trashy Thing
desc: A piece of trash from the Trash Can.

name: Wooden Plank
desc: A wooden board from the Strange Sign.

name: Chubby Serpent Tail
desc: A serpent's chubby tail.

name: Safety First Board
desc: A sign carried by Safety First.

name: Rock Fragment
desc: A rock fragment obtained from Baby Boulder Muncher.

name: Ore Fragment
desc: A rock fragment obtained from Big Boulder Muncher. Looks like this can be carved into a jewel...

name: Boulder Shield
desc: A strong shield made from rocks.

name: Shovel
desc: A work shovel carried by Racoco.

name: Big Spider Antenna
desc: The antenna of a Big Spider.

name: Cart
desc: A cart pushed around by Cart Bears.

name: Raccoon Tail
desc: A Racaroni's fluffy tail.

name: Safety Hat
desc: A safety hat worn by Raco.

name: Ore Muncher Sample
desc: A sample taken from an Ore Muncher.

name: Flaming Rue
desc: Rare Rue ore imbued with the heat and pressure of the underground.

name: Guard Robot L's Memory Chip
desc: Guard Robot L's memory chip. It's used to control the robot.

name: Security System Deactivation Key
desc: A card key that can be used to deactivate the Security System.

name: Security System Parts
desc: Parts that make up the Enhanced Security System.

name: Filament Lightbulb
desc: A broken bulb from the head of an Android.

name: Android Parts
desc: Broken parts from an Android.

name: Poison Gas
desc: Poison Gas created from a Poison Gas Generator.

name: Futuroid Part 1
desc: One of the many parts needed to make a Futuroid. Bring all 7 parts to Gaga along with an Electronic Heart. You can get a permanent version of the Electronic Heart from Gachapons, and a limited version from Nack in Ardentmill. \r\n

name: Futuroid Part 2
desc: One of the many parts needed to make a Futuroid. Bring all 7 parts to Gaga along with an Electronic Heart. You can get a permanent version of the Electronic Heart from Gachapons, and a limited version from Nack in Ardentmill. \r\n

name: Futuroid Part 3
desc: One of the many parts needed to make a Futuroid. Bring all 7 parts to Gaga along with an Electronic Heart. You can get a permanent version of the Electronic Heart from Gachapons, and a limited version from Nack in Ardentmill. \r\n

name: Futuroid Part 4
desc: One of the many parts needed to make a Futuroid. Bring all 7 parts to Gaga along with an Electronic Heart. You can get a permanent version of the Electronic Heart from Gachapons, and a limited version from Nack in Ardentmill. \r\n

name: Futuroid Part 5
desc: One of the many parts needed to make a Futuroid. Bring all 7 parts to Gaga along with an Electronic Heart. You can get a permanent version of the Electronic Heart from Gachapons, and a limited version from Nack in Ardentmill. \r\n

name: Futuroid Part 6
desc: One of the many parts needed to make a Futuroid. Bring all 7 parts to Gaga along with an Electronic Heart. You can get a permanent version of the Electronic Heart from Gachapons, and a limited version from Nack in Ardentmill. \r\n

name: Futuroid Part 7
desc: One of the many parts needed to make a Futuroid. Bring all 7 parts to Gaga along with an Electronic Heart. You can get a permanent version of the Electronic Heart from Gachapons, and a limited version from Nack in Ardentmill. \r\n

name: Gelatin Blob
desc: A transparent blob of gelatin. Do not eat.

name: Red Megran Fruit
desc: A red fruit from Megran that is used as a rare medicine ingredient.

name: Rumo Leaf
desc: A rare leaf from Rumo. It's full of life, but loses it the more you handle it.

name: Test Flask
desc: A flask used for all kinds of fancy science-looking things.

name: Purple Liquid
desc: Unidentified purple liquid that might be toxic. Or delicious. Hard to tell.

name: Steel Fragment
desc: Iron Mutae are covered in this stuff.

name: Reinforced Steel Fragment
desc: Just try breaking this steel. I dare you.

name: Mithril Fragment
desc: This came from a Mithril Mutae, probably not by choice.

name: Reinforced Mithril Fragment
desc: Was part of a Reinforced Mithril Mutae, before you decided to recycle it.

name: Decayed Scorpion Stinger
desc: This scorpion stinger has seen better days.

name: Test Beaker
desc: A beaker that just REEKS of science.

name: Clean Dew
desc: You need this for Homunculus Alchemy. No one knows why.

name: Magic Blood
desc: Extracted from a Homunculus. The enchantments have the ability to reveal truths.

name: Alchemy Stone
desc: A mystical stone forged by alchemy. It's a pretty safe bet that it contains some kind of power.

name: Decayed Wasp Stinger
desc: A nasty old stinger. Still looks dangerous.

name: Tangled Wires
desc: Don't shock yourself!

name: Plug
desc: Even Neo Huroids need to be plugged in.

name: Broken Iron Heart
desc: A broken mechanical heart. It looks like it can be repaired and used again, if it can work through its issues.

name: Poacher Certificate
desc: Poachers carry these certificates around to tell each other apart.

name: Soft Cottons
desc: This Teddy Bear really spilled his guts.

name: Cute Panda Doll
desc: Looks just like a real panda!

name: Youngest Duckie
desc: A cute toy duck on wheels. Look at it go!

name: Plastic Toy Sword
desc: A toy soldier's plastic sword. Somewhat less effective than you current weapon.

name: Robo Battery
desc: Still has a little juice left in it.

name: Master Robo Battery
desc: Custom batteries are such a pain to replace.

name: Targa Paw
desc: Targa's foot. Ew!

name: Small Spring
desc: A tiny spring of a clock. Couldn't be THAT important.

name: Table Clock
desc: This thing just keeps on ticking.

name: Small Cog
desc: Just another cog in the machine...

name: Small Springy Worm
desc: A worm that feeds on time. Maybe it's a metaphor...

name: Clock Spring Component
desc: Grandpa Clock's still got some old springs kicking around. He really should get with the times.

name: Sealed Teddy
desc: This teddy bear is like a luxury suite for ghosts. For children 2 and up!

name: Shackled Paw
desc: This teddy paw was holding another teddy. It's bears all the way down.

name: Broken Teddy
desc: This plushy used to be possessed by a ghost. Don't worry, the ghost is gone. Probably.

name: Freed Spirit
desc: A spirit from the Soul Teddy. Looks pretty happy to be free.

name: Giant Grandpa Clock
desc: Big and unwieldy. Watches have come a long way from this.

name: Piece of Time
desc: You know how people always wish for more time? Well, here's your chance!

name: Colorful Hat
desc: Hat. Colorful. Good.

name: Hat Dealie-Bobber
desc: This ball popped right off of Lazy Buffy's hat. Like everything else in Maple World, it looks like it holds a mysterious power.

name: Alishar's Key
desc: How's Alishar supposed to get into his car now?!

name: Ghost Pirate Wheel
desc: Looks like those Ghost Pirates won't be going anywhere in a hurry.

name: Dual Ghost Pirate Wheel
desc: Good job dooming the Dual Ghost Pirates to drift aimlessly for eternity.

name: Klock's Broken Clock
desc: Still right twice a day.

name: Dark Klock's Broken Clock
desc: Still right twice a day. But only about evil things.

name: Viking's Token
desc: Needed to get into all the coolest Viking parties.

name: Viking Helm
desc: You can smell the mead and sweat on this thing from a mile away.

name: Frozen Time
desc: Should still be good if you thaw it out.

name: Time Jar
desc: This can keep the Phantom Watch bottled up.

name: Damaged Hourglass
desc: It looks broken, but the sand doesn't spill out. Mysterious!

name: Memory Cloth
desc: The official colors of the Memory Monks.

name: Memory Cone Hat
desc: A hat that is worn by Memory Monk Trainees. Obviously a mark of respect.

name: Memory Helm
desc: A hat that is worn by Memory Guardians. Helps keep the memories in.

name: Memory Heart
desc: Heart of the Chief Memory Guardian. Doesn't he need this?

name: Dodo Helm
desc: The Whale of Time is rather fond of this hat.

name: Qualm Cloth
desc: The official colors of the Qualm Monks.

name: Qualm Cone Hat
desc: A hat that is worn by Qualm Monk Trainees. They have no qualms with it.

name: Qualm Helm
desc: A hat that is worn by Qualm Guardians. Keeps them qualm.

name: Qualm Heart
desc: Heart of the Chief Qualm Guardian. Kinda gross when you think about it.

name: Lilynouch Mask
desc: Protects the identity of Lilynouch, the Ice Knight.

name: Oblivion Cloth
desc: The official colors of the Oblivion Monks.

name: Oblivion Cone Hat
desc: A hat that is worn by Oblivion Monk Trainees. They seem oblivious to it.

name: Oblivion Helm
desc: A hat that is worn by Oblivion Guardians. Protects from oblivion-related injuries.

name: Oblivion Heart
desc: Heart of the Chief Oblivion Guardian. He might want it back at some point.

name: Lyka's Horn
desc: Not the kind you play.

name: Kentaurus King Flame
desc: A royal source of power.

name: Griffey's Broken Horn
desc: A noble Griffey horn. Great for making jewelry.

name: Fibo's Head
desc: The head of Fibo. Collect 6 different parts, the Administrator will purify them.

name: Fibo's Body
desc: The body of Fibo. Collect 6 different parts, the Administrator will purify them.

name: Fibo's Right Arm
desc: The right arm of Fibo. Collect 6 different parts, the Administrator will purify them.

name: Fibo's Left Arm
desc: The left arm of Fibo. Collect 6 different parts, the Administrator will purify them.

name: Fibo's Right Leg
desc: The right leg of Fibo. Collect 6 different parts, the Administrator will purify them.

name: Fibo's Left Leg
desc: The right leg of Fibo. Collect 6 different parts, the Administrator will purify them.

name: Broken Blade (Blue)
desc: This would probably make a great weapon if it was still whole. Look at all those icy runes...

name: Broken Hilt (Blue)
desc: Imagine the weapon that must have been attached to this frozen thing.

name: Broken Shaft (Blue)
desc: All that's missing is the ball. Maybe it melted. Too bad that's the important part.

name: Broken Bow (Blue)
desc: Even as busted up as it is, this bow looks like it could shoot some wicked frosty arrows.

name: Broken Feather (Blue)
desc: Somehow this feather is as cold and heavy as a gigantic block of ice. Magic!

name: Broken Blade (Red)
desc: The runes on this thing are hot to the touch. What kind of weapon was it...?

name: Broken Hilt (Red)
desc: Despite the wrappings, this hilt is almost too hot to handle.

name: Broken Shaft (Red)
desc: Even without the ball, this thing is hot enough to do some damage.

name: Broken Bow (Red)
desc: You can tell by the markings that this bow used to shoot some white-hot arrows.

name: Broken Feather (Red)
desc: A decorative feather that's both hot and as heavy as a burning rock.

name: Broken Blade (Black)
desc: You're not sure what the runes on this say, but you get the feeling it's nothing good.

name: Broken Hilt (Black)
desc: This hilt feels terrible and threatening, despite not having anything dangerous attached to it.

name: Broken Shaft (Black)
desc: It's just a chain and a shaft, but they radiate such a sense of dread...

name: Broken Bow (Black)
desc: You can feel the agony of lost souls shot through with this ancient bow. Creepy.

name: Broken Feather (Black)
desc: A feather that weighs much more than it looks. It's also totally evil.

name: Basic Magician's Cloth
desc: Even cheap cloth like this is infused with magic. You can't throw a rock without hitting a magical artifact, it seems.

name: Intermediate Magician's Cloth
desc: This dark fabric radiates mysterious power. That makes sense, considering its intended use.

name: Advanced Magician's Cloth
desc: A piece of mysterious fabric surrounded by black energy. Guess evil magic is pretty popular these days.

name: Hawk Claw
desc: A sharp claw from a poacher's hawk.

name: Grave Robber Certificate
desc: Grave robbers carry these certificates around to tell each other apart.

name: Hunting Dog's Fang
desc: A fang from the grave robber's hunting dogs. Seems sharp enough to pierce anything.

name: Neon Bat Wings
desc: A pair of glowing wings from a Neon Bat. Might work like a flashlight in the dark.

name: Glowing Primary Rock Fragment
desc: A fragment of a glowing primary rock.

name: Spirit Substance
desc: A curious substance from a Peace Spirit.

name: Darkness Fragment
desc: This piece of darkness is thick with shadow.

name: Omen's Fragment
desc: You feel the same mysterious energy in this that you felt from the Omen.

name: Master Omen's Fragment
desc: You feel the same mysterious energy in this that you felt from the Master Omen.

name: Demolisher Part
desc: A part from the Barrier Demolisher.

name: Surveillance Robot Memory Chip
desc: This memory chip is all that's left of a Surveillance Robot.

name: Frozen Rose Petal
desc: A rose petal frozen from centuries in the snow. Doesn't seem tasty, so you might as well sell it at the shop.

name: Loose Chain
desc: An old chain that clangs around in your inventory. All that noise is making you mad. You should sell it at the shop.

name: Dried Rose Vine
desc: A dried rose vine. It makes the Golems look a bit prettier.

name: Shiny Flower Powder
desc: Shining bees drop  these shining powders. Maybe the shops will take this shiny thing for a lot of money.

name: Suspicious Lime Powder
desc: When you watch them closely, you can see that these lime powders are moving by themselves. Suspicious!

name: Apple
desc: It's produced in farms around the Veracent Village.

name: Grapes
desc: They're produced in farms around the Veracent Village.

name: Samuel's Ingredient
desc: Samuel's Ingredient

name: Weird thing
desc: Not sure what it is. He wants 30 of them.

name: Something weird
desc: Sonia said it's proof that I shouldn't believe Gilbert.

name: His Trace
desc: The Courage Statue said I would know who he was when I got the 'hint'. He's a liar.

name: Invitation Letter
desc: It just says "Welcome". How lame.

name: Talisman
desc: The Wisdom Statue said it would help defeate Vale. Not sure.

name: Rare Treasure
desc: A treasure that Icy Blue Kerberos has. I can hardly believe it.

name: Life is
desc: A note that says "Life is".

name: C
desc: A note that says "C".

name: between
desc: A note that says "between".

name: B
desc: A note that says "B".

name: and
desc: A note that says "and".

name: D
desc: A note that says "D".

name: Trace of Courage
desc: A manifested trace of courage.

name: Lost Toy
desc: A toy for children.

name: Happy Seed
desc: This seed is believed to generate happy energy, and hated by monsters due to its distinctive odor.

name: Treasure Chest Key
desc: An old key that opens a treasure chest.

name: Shiny Crystal
desc: A remarkably shiny crystal.

name: Blood Pirate Emblem
desc: An emblem earned from defeating the Captain Blood Pirates.

name: Siren's Talon
desc: Claws left behind by a Siren. Very sharp.

name: Coral Bit
desc: A bit of coral that has broken free from a coral reef.

name: Ocean Rock
desc: A shard of ocean rock that broke free from a reef.

name: Cat Mask
desc: A mask worn by Coastal Cats.

name: Cat Claws
desc: A Gray Tomcat's claws.

name: Broken Delfino Sword
desc: A broken one-handed Delfino sword.

name: Broken Delfino Goggles
desc: A pair of broken Delfino goggles.

name: Broken Delfino Staff
desc: A broken Delfino staff.

name: Broken Delfino Claw
desc: A broken Delfino claw.

name: Broken Delfino Spear
desc: A broken Delfino spear.

name: Ripped Cloak
desc: A fragment from Riverson's cloak.

name: Brown Furball
desc: A ball of fur from a brown wolf.

name: Blue Furball
desc: A ball of fur from a blue wolf.

name: Blue Pirate Hat
desc: A blue hat that Dawnveil pirates wear.

name: Red Pirate Hat
desc: A red hat that Dawnveil pirates wear.

name: Nightwhip
desc: A whip used by Guild Assassins.

name: Nightcutter
desc: A blade used by Guild Assassins.

name: Nightrobe
desc: A robe worn by Guild Assassins.

name: Red Scarf Scrap
desc: A scrap from the scarf worn by Il Capo.

name: Dried Caterpillar
desc: Dried caterpillar jerky. It's a yummy food for baby foxes.

name: Spotted Wings
desc: These are the wings of a ladybug. They make good meals for baby foxes.

name: Sparrow Egg
desc: An egg stolen from a sparrow's nest. It makes a delicious treat for foxes.

name: Mouse Tail
desc: A tail from a Balloon Mouse. It's a yummy fox treat.

name: Red Frog Legs
desc: Frog legs from a Red Poison Frog. Be careful, they're poisonous all over.

name: Green Frog Legs
desc: Frog legs from a Green Poison Frog. Be careful, it's poisonous all over.

name: Mohawk Feather
desc: A fuzzy feather from a Delinquent Chick. It's covered in rebellious hair wax.

name: Rocker Feather
desc: A fuzzy feather from a Punk Chick. It's covered in hard rock hair wax.

name: Mane Fur
desc: Fur from a hyena's back. Nice spots.

name: Fang
desc: A long fang from a hyena. It symbolizes bravery, because someone had to go in there to get it.

name: Rock-Paper-Scissors Ticket
desc: This sloppy Rock-Paper-Scissors Ticket says #c'teeket'#. Lil Zakum needs some spelling lessons.

name: Ancient Evil Eye Tail
desc: A tail of an Evil Eye that used to live in the Ancient Cave. It's glossy and lustrous, unlike the tails of those other loser Evil Eyes.

name: Clockwise Labyrinth Key
desc: Drop it on the portal in the room to rotate the room's destination once clockwise.

name: Red Sand Powder
desc: Red Sand Powder dropped by a Red Sand Dwarf. Used to explore the 29th floor of the Tower of Oz. If you gather 10 Red Sand Powders, a Red Sand Crystal will appear beneath a tree on the left.

name: Counterclockwise Labyrinth Key
desc: Drop it on the portal in the room to rotate the room's destination once counterclockwise.

name: Yellow Leather
desc: A piece of yellow leather dropped by a Yellow Curly Cow. It's thin and light and doesn't tear easily. It would be great for clothing, but you have to use it to open the portal.

name: Purple Leather
desc: A piece of purple leather dropped by a Purple Curly Cow. It's a bit thick, but still looks luxurious. Get enough to escape the floor.

name: Orange Slime Liquid
desc: A substance from an Orange Ancient Slime. Gather 10 of this stuff and drop them on the Burning Altar to summon an Orange Ancient Slime.

name: Ancient Blue Turtle Egg
desc: An Ancient Blue Turtle's egg. Would make quite an omelet.

name: Ancient Orange Turtle Egg
desc: An Ancient Orange Turtle's egg. Would make quite a breakfast.

name: Gold Richie Figure
desc: A really cheesy figurine of Gold Richie, but you need it for the Gold Richie's Safe Event.

name: Gold Richie Figure
desc: A really cheesy figurine of Gold Richie, but you need it for the Gold Richie's Safe Event.

name: Gold Richie Figure
desc: A really cheesy figurine of Gold Richie, but you need it for the Gold Richie's Safe Event.

name: Gold Richie Figure
desc: A really cheesy figurine of Gold Richie, but you need it for the Gold Richie's Safe Event.

name: 検出されたナノウェーブ
desc: 「ドン・おネエ」から検出されたナノウェーブ。微量ではあるが、カブキ町の人々からもナノウェーブが検出された。これを手掛かりにカブキ町に隠れているネイトロジーの決戦兵器を見つけられそうだ。

name: Skeledog's Bone
desc: A mysterious bone. You might be able to make a spicy soup with this bone.\r\n\r\nIt's one of the ingredients for the delicious lunch, and #cif you have 3 of them regardless of type, you will be able to make a delicious lunch by double clicking them.#Do not be afraid, go ahead!

name: The Key
desc: It's a Heart Key which allows you to open the hearts of people who are eating lunch. You could use it to have people change their mind.\r\n\r\nIt's one of the ingredients for the delicious lunch, and #cif you have 3 of them regardless of type, you will be able to make a delicious lunch by double clicking them.#Do not be afraid and go ahead!

desc: 오염된 요괴를 처치하면 얻을 수 있는 혼이다. 무슨 이유에서인지 오다군은 요괴에 여러가지 주술을 시험하고 있는 듯하다.

name: 죽은 사람도 일어날 만큼 엄청 쓴 약초
desc: 새로 온 무장을 위해 얻은 약초. 죽은 사람이 일어나는 이유는 약초가 너무 쓰기 때문이라고 한다.

name: 엄청 쓴 약초로 만든 엄청 쓴 회복약
desc: 엄청 쓴 약초를 3개나 넣어서 만든 매우 쓴 회복약이다. 기절한 사람만 먹을 수 있을 법한 비쥬얼이다.

name: 마츠야마 가문의 신기
desc: 마츠야마 가문에 내려져 오는 거울이다. 세상이 혼돈에 빠질 때 난세를 극복하게 도와준다는 전설을 가지고 있다.

name: 소년이 잃어버린 보따리
desc: 히에이잔의 울고 있는 소년이 찾아달라고 부탁한 보따리다. 약간 촌스러운 꽃무늬이다.

name: 노히메의 지령서

name: 빨간 단지

name: Watermelon Slice
desc: A tasty-looking slice of red watermelon. It's good for your health to eat the seeds as well.

name: Fruit Cocktail
desc: A tall fruit cocktail is everyone's friend. It inspires respect for the one who mixed it.

name: Ice Block
desc: This cool block of ice will turn your inventory into a refrigerator.

name: Sweet Hoof
desc: A sweet hoof from the Pinedeer.

name: Spicy Hoof
desc: A spicy hoof from the Bighorn Pinedeer. You'll need plenty of water to down this.

name: Greasy Peel
desc: A greasy peel from Ewenana.

name: Sour Peel
desc: A sour peel from Ramanana. Makes you salivate.

name: Fresh Mane
desc: A fresh mane from Flyon. It has no taste.

name: Zesty Mane
desc: A zesty mane from Angry Flyon. Where does the zest come from?

name: Soft Sole
desc: A soft sole from an Unripe Wolfruit. It's soft but it doesn't smell good.

name: Chewy Sole
desc: A sole with a chewy texture from a Ripe Wolfruit. For some reason it still doesn't taste ripe.

name: Savory Fin
desc: Rough fins from a Green Catfish. Eating this could scratch up the roof of your mouth.

name: Tart Fins
desc: Tart fins from a Blue Catfish. Very pungent!

name: Crunchy Shell
desc: A shell from a Rhyturtle that has completely dried out. Loaded with essential vitamins and minerals.

name: Soft Shell
desc: A soft shell from Boss Rhyturtle. You'll need to chew it for awhile.

name: Slimy Feather
desc: A slimy feather from Crilia. Lots of empty calories here.

name: Sticky Feather
desc: A sticky feather from Patriarch Crilia. It tastes better than it looks.

name: Unpleasant Talon
desc: An unpleasant talon from Birdshark. The texture isn't great and the flavor is even worse.

name: Chewy Talon
desc: A chewy talon from Patriarch Birdshark. The texture is great but something about it repulses you.

name: Slurpy Fruit
desc: A magical fruit that makes any food taste great. Totally worth the hassle of harvesting.

name: Fried Treat
desc: A crispy delight that's chock full of flavor.

name: Savory Stir Fry
desc: A stir fry that's tasty enough to blow your mind.

name: Nummy Noodles
desc: Noodles cooked al dente.

name: Steamy Surprise
desc: It's an unusual combination, but this steamed food tastes great.

name: Weird Wrap
desc: You've never experienced a wrap like this!

name: Gamey Soup
desc: It's an interesting taste sensation, that's for sure.

name: Mystery Roast
desc: What's inside this roast? As long as it's good, who cares?

name: Berry Bouquet
desc: Almost as pretty as it is delicious!

name: Fried Squish
desc: Squish a bunch of tasty stuff together, and get something tasty! Amazing!

name: Dumpling Delights
desc: These dumplings delight as they go down the hatch.

name: Funky Pizza
desc: Feel the funk with a groovy slice.

name: Juicy Buns
desc: Look how thick these are! Amazing!

name: Yucky Pickles
desc: Who would even cook pickles like this?

name: Chewy Porridge
desc: How can porridge be chewy...?

name: Fruit Salad
desc: All the best fruits, mixed to perfection!

name: Spicy Sausage
desc: That's a spicy sausage!

name: Monster's Anguish
desc: [Item used in Secret Stories]\r\nIt's a glob of concentrated anguish.\r\nThe Girl said it's used in making a potion that channels the dead...

name: Eau de Mort
desc: [Item used in Secret Stories]\r\nIt's the concentrated stench of death and decay.\r\nApparently it's needed for the ritual.

name: Lumber for Repairs
desc: [Item used in Secret Stories]\r\nIt's lumber to be used for repairing the buildings damaged by the Snow Monster.

name: Stone for Repairs
desc: [Item used in Secret Stories]\r\nIt's stone to be used for repairing the buildings damaged by the Snow Monster.

name: Korean Beef Pack
desc: This finely aged Korean Beef Pack will be delicious however you prepare it. The package contains 14oz of Rib Eye, 14oz of Top Blade Chuck, 14oz of Short Rib, 10oz of Sirloin, and 10oz of Ribeye.

name: Delicious Apple & Pear Gift Box
desc: A box of delicious, organic apples and pears. They'll stay fresh for a long time if you seal them in individual plastic bags.

name: Scholar's Rice
desc: Rice that has been imbued with the integrity and honesty of a scholar. Each spoonful builds your moral character.

name: Balrog's Key
desc: A small golden key that was hanging from around a Balrog's neck. It looks a little too small to open a lock on the Huge Door. Maybe it opens a lock for something smaller, like a diary?

name: Warrior's Token
desc: This fancy trinket serves as proof that its bearer is a warrior without peer.

name: Food Basket
desc: The food basket recovered from a Moustrosity.

name: Treasure Basket
desc: A treasure basket recovered from a Moustrosity.

name: Child's Toy
desc: A toy that a Papercraft critter was playing with. A child might want this.

name: Frozen Treat
desc: A frozen treat the Papercraft critter was carrying. Looks tasty!

name: Bleached Olive Tree
desc: A withered-looking olive tree. It appears to have lost all color.

name: Black Raven Feather
desc: A raven's feather. It's as black as the night.

name: Worm
desc: A worm that inhabits the frozen trees of #cSlumbering Dragon Island#. It's good for #cfishing# bait. They'll squirm away when you #clog out# or leave #cSlumbering Dragon Island#.

name: Shrimp
desc: A shrimp that can survive the bitter cold of #cSlumbering Dragon Island#. It's good for #cfishing# bait. They'll flop away when you #clog out# or leave #cSlumbering Dragon Island#.

name: Golden Worm
desc: This worm gives off a soft golden light. It's a rare curiosity found only on #cSlumbering Dragon Island#. It's good for #cfishing# bait. It'll squirm away when you #clog out# or leave #cSlumbering Dragon Island#.

name: Golden Shrimp
desc: This shrimp has a strange golden shell that makes it nearly unbreakable. Despite that, it's good for #cfishing# bait. It'll flop away when you #clog out# or leave #cSlumbering Dragon Island#.

name: Diamond
desc: A diamond synthesized with materials from Slumbering Dragon Island. You can catch rare fish using this as #cfishing bait#.

name: Hatsar's Golden Shrimp
desc: A gold shrimp from Hatsar that can be caught in a special oasis. You can exchange them for gold coins.

name: Adler's White Key
desc: A white key you received from Adler. \r\nIt's one of the keys needed to open the Huge Door in the Land of Beginnings.

name: Lightning-Touched Wooden Key
desc: A key discovered inside a tree in the Land of Innocence after a thunderstorm.\r\nIt's one of the keys needed to open the Huge Door in the Land of Beginnings.

name: God of Battle's Key
desc: A key given to you in the Land of Warriors when you were mistaken for the 'God of Battle' in your enlarged state. \r\nIt's one of the keys needed to open the Huge Door in the Land of Beginnings.

name: Golden Key
desc: A key found among Mansa's treasure-puke pile. \r\nIt's one of the keys needed to open the Huge Door in the Land of Beginnings.

name: Raven Black Key
desc: A pitch-black key swallowed by a raven. \r\nIt's one of the keys needed to open the Huge Door in the Land of Beginnings.

name: Crystalline Key
desc: A flashy crystalline key found inside a diary. \r\nIt's one of the keys needed to open the Huge Door in the Land of Beginnings.

name: Cast Iron Key
desc: A key made of cast iron given to you by Horemheb, the wealthiest person in the Land of Riches. It was the least valuable of his possessions. \r\nIt's one of the keys needed to open the Huge Door in the Land of Beginnings.

name: Yellow Mage's Key
desc: The Yellow Mage's plastic key. It feels cheap, but it's bursting with malevolent energy. \r\nIt's one of the keys needed to open the Huge Door in the Land of Beginnings.

name: Carved Stone Key
desc: An old man who carves tombstones carved this key out of stone. \r\nIt's one of the keys needed to open the Huge Door in the Land of Beginnings.

name: Molded Clay Key
desc: An old man who carves tombstones molded this key from clay. \r\nIt's one of the keys needed to open the Huge Door in the Land of Beginnings.

name: Heart-shaped Key
desc: A heart-shaped toy key you received from a child in the Land of Innocence. \r\nIt's one of the keys needed to open the Huge Door in the Land of Beginnings.

name: Striped Candy Key
desc: A key made of striped candy you got from a child in the Land of Innocence. \r\nIt's one of the keys needed to open the Huge Door in the Land of Beginnings.

desc: Once upon a time, a 50-million-year-old icicle was granted life, and became the Mistress of Ice. It's said the icicle formed slowly, growing 0.0001 mm every year. Someone has been writing bits of her legend down on paper and spreading it around. Something amazing will occur when you gather all of the papers and speak the three-digit password.\r\n\r\n#cThere's a number written on the icicle but you can't make it out.#

name: Rainbow Dew
desc: A brilliant Rainbow Dew eaten by Orange Mushroom.\r\nYou can drag it to feed Orange Mushroom.

stats.1: You gave Rainbow Dew to Orange Mushroom.

desc: A key held by Guardroid Model 13 at #cAspire#.

desc: A work order used for work on the #cWondroid# project at #cAspire Industries#.

desc: A research diary detailing the entire creation and development of the #cWondroid# at #cAspire Industries#.\r\n#c[Classified TOP SECRET]\r\nClearance Level 3#

name: Rune-Engraved Elunite Crystal
desc: An Elunite Crystal engraved with alien runes. It feels unlike any other Elunite Crystal you've discovered.

name: Churmble Specimen
desc: A research sample harvested from the crystal-coated Eluna lifeform known as a 'Churmble.'

name: Thalia Floatyfish Specimen
desc: A research sample from the 'Thalia Floatyfish.' It looks more like a monster than a plant.

name: Deadly Biteysnek Specimen
desc: A research sample from the 'Deadly Biteysnek'. It appears to be capable of asexual reproduction at a cellular level, explaining the lifeform's abundance on this planet. Smells like chicken.

name: Captured Churmble
desc: Churmble that has been successfully captured and placed in a cage. You feel kind of bad, but science requires sacrifice.

name: Captured Atlassian Crab
desc: Atlas that has been successfully captured and put in a cage. That's no drab little crab. It's as shiny as they come.

name: Spaceflight Research Laboratory Photo
desc: A photo of a ruined facility that appears to have once been used to research spaceflight.

name: Photo of Water Filtration Facility Ruins
desc: A photo of a ruined facility that appears to have once been used to extract and purify water.

name: Sub-Zero Hunt EXP Boost
desc: You gain a powerful EXP buff when you hunt monsters in the Sub-Zero Hunt.

name: Dark Residue
desc: It's a dark residue commonly obtained from the monsters found at Gold Beach.

name: Old Bone Fragment
desc: It's an old bone fragment that can be obtained from monsters at the Excavation Site. Despite its shabby appearance, it has great archaeological value.

name: Drake Tissue Sample
desc: It's a tissue harvested from a Drake. Apparently it's quite valuable for biological research.

name: Artificial Organism Tissue Sample
desc: It's a tissue sample from an artificial organism created by way of alchemy. It could be quite valuable for study.

name: Mechanical Lifeform Component
desc: A component from a mechanical lifeform. It appears to have been crafted through the synergy of alchemy and engineering.

name: Horntail's Evil Energy
desc: It's an energy commonly found from monsters in Minar Forest influenced by Horntail. How you managed to collect it, only the developers can answer.

name: Empty Ryuul Data Disk
desc: It's a data storage device crafted using advance Ryuul technology. It's calibrated to interface with the data collector in the Swamp Region.

name: Photo of Stellar Observatory Ruins
desc: A photo of a ruined structure that appears to have once been used to study the stars.

name: Full Ryuul Data Disk
desc: It's a data storage device crafted using advance Ryuul technology.  It's filled with data from the Swamp Region.

name: Empty Ryuul Data Disk
desc: It's a data storage device crafted using advance Ryuul technology.  Use it to collect data on Drake monsters.

name: Full Ryuul Data Disk
desc: It's a data storage device crafted using advance Ryuul technology.  It's filled with data on Drake monsters.

name: Lidium Sample
desc: It's the Lidium ore that Eremos asked you to obtain.

name: Ryuul Mobile Data Collector
desc: It's a Ryuul data storage device that's been jury-rigged into a mobile data collector. You can use it to record data on the enemies you fight in Ellin Forest.\r\n\r\nApparently it's powered by a micro-singularity, so unless you're looking to destroy two versions of Maple World at once, maybe don't break it.

name: Zakum Fragment Sample
desc: It's a fragment of Zakum's statue you collected for Eremos. He seemed eager to analyze it.

name: Empty Ryuul Data Disk
desc: It's a data storage device crafted using advance Ryuul technology.  Use it to collect data on the Minar Forest region.

name: Full Ryuul Data Disk
desc: It's a data storage device crafted using advance Ryuul technology.  It's filled with data on the Minar Forest region.

name: Dry Firewood
desc: Dry firewood that Volcano Bugs love. It has Volcano Bug droppings on it but still burns okay.

name: Resin
desc: Resin that Beetles love. Beetles tend to have mouths sticky with resin.

name: Mountain Turtle Egg
desc: The egg of a Mountain Turtle. Don't eat it raw or you'll get a tummy ache!

name: Cast Iron Plate
desc: A cast iron plate that used to be part of a Hedgehog's body. It's slightly rusted.

name: Big Broken Nail
desc: A big nail that used to be stuck on a Mutant Hedgehog's body. It's slightly rusted.

name: Mutant Hedgehog Fur
desc: Mutant Hedgehog fur, hidden beneath cast iron plates and big nails.

name: Nutria Hind Leg
desc: The hind leg of a Nutria. Melts in your mouth!

name: Still Fluid
desc: Fluid from inside a waste drum. Strangely, it doesn't flow.

name: Unburning Flame
desc: A flame found inside a waste drum. Strangely, it doesn't burn.

name: Soft Scrap Iron
desc: A heap of scrap metal from inside a waste drum. Strangely, it's soft and malleable.

name: Flaming Wiggling Tail
desc: The wiggling tail of a Specter Stray Dog. It almost seems alive.

name: First Weapon Part
desc: Looks used.

name: Second Weapon Part
desc: Looks used.

name: Mutant Hedgehog Fur Tuft
desc: A tuft of fur. You should take it to Coney.

name: Mutant Nutria Blood
desc: The blood of a Mutant Nutria. You get the feeling you shouldn't touch it with your bare hands..

name: Poison Remover
desc: Used by Mr. Hazard's men to clean their hideout.

name: Onyx Stonegar Magic Stone
desc: A stone that absorbs magical energy from Onyx Stonegar.

name: Decent Wooden Shield
desc: A wooden shield used by a Specter Shieldbearer. It's fairly big and sturdy.

name: Animal Oil
desc: Speeyor fat burns really well.

name: Yellow Speeyor Fur Coat
desc: Yellow Speeyor's noble fur coat. Terribly soft.

name: Dinodon Ribs
desc: The ribs of a Dinodon. Its chewy texture can't be beat.

name: Angelic Buster Figurine
desc: An Angelic Buster Figurine that's rare because it's hand-stamped.

name: Eurenth's Letter
desc: A letter from Eurenth that contains information about the Central Region.

name: Dinogoth Shoulder Meat
desc: Meat from a Dinogoth's shoulder. Popular item for army supplies.

name: Hunter's Arena EXP Increase
desc: You gain a powerful EXP increase buff when you hunt monsters in the Hunter's Arena.

name: Mechanical Parts
desc: A big nail that used to be stuck on a Mutant Hedgehog's body. It could be useful for modding machines.

name: Grossular Shard
desc: A small and shiny crystal shard you can get from a Green Grossular.

name: Amethyst Shard
desc: A small and shiny crystal shard you can get from a Purple Amethyst.

name: Dean's Bag
desc: Dean's bag. It is full of useless junk.

name: Dean's Notebook
desc: A notebook's never been used. Dean's name is written crookedly on the back cover.

name: Pyrope Shard
desc: A small and shiny crystal shard you can get from a Fire Pyrope.

name: Obsidian Shard
desc: A small and shiny crystal shard you can get from a Dark Obsidian.

name: Gold Shard
desc: A hefty piece of shiny metal. It could be useful for making mechanical parts.

name: Vinegold Shard
desc: A hefty piece of shiny metal. The surface is covered in vines because it was buried in the forest for a long time.

name: Larimar Shard
desc: A small and shiny crystal shard you can get from a Blue Larimar.

name: Gravi Stonegar Magic Stone
desc: A stone that exudes magical energy. Obtained from Gravi Stonegar.

name: Tier 1 Ingredient: Rice

name: Tier 1 Ingredient: Tuna
